output.reason: On its own, the cited bullet [ev-7e0c2d4b7db5] only names the metric `cortex_kv_request_duration_seconds_count`. The intro to its section [ev-1f419676f177] fills in the rest. It says this release changes metrics that start with `cortex_` to start with `loki_`, and the bullet is one of the listed "metrics [that] will be changed". So the change is a rename from `cortex_kv_request_duration_seconds_count` to `loki_kv_request_duration_seconds_count`. The same intro gives the exposure condition: deployments where `metrics_namespace` is left at its new default `loki` (setting it to `cortex` keeps the old name). The consequence is that the metric appears under the new `loki_` name, so queries that use the old name stop matching. That intro also says `metrics_namespace` is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release.
